how_to_recognize_match: User centers performance, spectacle, or provocation as public truth-pressure.
User chooses intensity with visible cost, audience, or consequence over polite restraint.
User names release, appetite, or sensation as part of an act rather than private leverage or generic aggression.
how_to_recognize_mismatch: User only wants generic BR aggression, random disruption, harmful posturing, or evil-party styling without performance, audience, or cost.
User centers Boros protection, Izzet invention, Golgari survival/rot, Orzhov debt, Gruul anti-civilization rage, Prismari craft, Jund survival appetite, Grixis leverage, or Mardu martial code first.
User treats harm, shock, or rule-breaking as the whole point rather than bounded spectacle or transgression.
questions_to_ask_when_uncertain: Is the disruption meant to perform a truth in public, release pressure with visible cost, or only create heat?

Spectacle is the official Rakdos mechanic and a consequence-gated placement anchor.
Visible cost separates Rakdos from generic aggression or unframed disruption.
Provocation is source-bounded when tied to performance and public release.
Danger is retained only as official-role texture and bounded by the act/audience/consequence frame.
Release is a bounded interpretation of the official performance/provocation cluster.
Rakdos himself remains the source-backed key figure and patron.
Audience language is project synthesis from performance plus spectacle mechanics.
Transgression is bounded to public performance rather than generic rule-breaking.
The packet must suppress black-red aggression without performance, spectacle, audience, or visible cost.

collision_guidance.separator: Rakdos requires performance, spectacle, audience, provocation, or visible cost; generic black-red heat does not certify it.
collision_guidance.ask: Is there an act with audience or consequence, or only black-red aggression?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when the answer lacks performance, spectacle, provocation, audience, or visible cost.

collision_guidance.separator: Rakdos externalizes appetite as public performance; mono-black-adjacent leverage can remain private.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the user performing release in public, or converting cost into private control?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when private leverage or self-protection leads without spectacle.

collision_guidance.separator: Rakdos adds black-red appetite and visible cost to impulse; mono-red direct feeling does not need the Cult frame.
collision_guidance.ask: Is there public transgression with cost, or only direct emotion and freedom?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when direct impulse lacks black-red appetite, audience, or visible consequence.

collision_guidance.separator: Boros routes urgency through protection and disciplined public duty; Rakdos routes intensity through release and transgressive spectacle.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the action accountable service or a performance that releases pressure?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when protection, accountability, and militarized order lead.

collision_guidance.separator: Gruul rage is rooted in dispossession and anti-civilization wildness; Rakdos performs release as spectacle.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the refusal wild grief against civilization, or staged social release?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when dispossession, wildness, or anti-civilization rage leads.

collision_guidance.separator: Golgari turns rot, survival, and recursion into ecology; Rakdos turns pressure into spectacle and cost.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the answer about survival/renewal, or performance with visible consequence?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when survival, rot, recursion, or lifecycle renewal leads.

collision_guidance.separator: Orzhov makes obligation and debt enforceable; Rakdos rejects restraint through release and public spectacle.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the pressure collectible obligation or public release?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when debt, hierarchy, status, or institutional exploitation leads.

collision_guidance.separator: Izzet turns urgency into experiment and invention; Rakdos turns intensity into performance and sensation.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the first move to build/test, or to perform and provoke?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when experiment, invention, infrastructure, or technical problem solving leads.

collision_guidance.separator: Prismari centers expressive craft and performance discipline; Rakdos centers transgression, indulgence, danger, and visible cost.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the act refined expressive craft, or transgressive social release?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when craft, study, or elemental expression leads over release and cost.

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis centers calculated survival leverage; Rakdos centers appetite, release, and public spectacle.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the answer about control/leverage, or appetite performed in public?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when survival leverage, necromantic resource use, or calculated control leads.

collision_guidance.separator: Jund centers instinct, predation, and survival hierarchy; Rakdos centers performance, provocation, and entertainment with cost.
collision_guidance.ask: Is appetite a survival hierarchy, or a staged act with consequence?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when predation, instinct, or survival appetite leads without performance.

collision_guidance.separator: Mardu centers martial oath, raid momentum, and honor; Rakdos lacks that white-coded discipline and centers spectacle, release, and public consequence.
collision_guidance.ask: Is speed serving a martial code, or becoming spectacle and release?
collision_guidance.suppress_if: Suppress Rakdos when martial oath, honor, conquest, or raid momentum leads.
